annotations.title: Share a live website for feedback

description: Turn a public web address (a published site, staging link or deploy preview) into an HTMLAnnotate review link where people click any element and comment on it. The page must open in a browser without signing in. Returns the review link and a private manage link for the owner. For HTML you wrote in this conversation, use share_html instead.

notify_email.description: Optional. The user's email, so HTMLAnnotate emails them when someone comments. Ask the user before sharing whether they want this.

url.description: The page address, for example https://example.com

name: share_url
title: Share a live website for feedback
